name: IOPaint object removal and upscale

upstream.name: IOPaint
upstream.used_as: server, unmodified (servers/iopaint); its web client (web_app/src) is the source of the headless port workloads/iopaint/iopaint_web.py

services.name: iopaint
services.command: iopaint start --model lama --device cuda --output-dir DIR --quality 100 --enable-interactive-seg --interactive-seg-model sam2_1_tiny --interactive-seg-device cuda --enable-realesrgan --realesrgan-model realesr-general-x4v3 --realesrgan-device cuda
services.pre_start_setting: IOPaint's vendored SAM 2 attention: OLD_GPU = MATH_KERNEL_ON = True (all scaled-dot-product-attention kernels allowed; needed on CUDA GPUs of compute capability >= 8.0)
services.torch: 2.4.1 with CUDA 12.1 wheels in setup.sh; development server: torch 2.4.x cu121 (exact version not recorded)

datasets.name: COCO 2017 val
datasets.license: annotations CC BY 4.0; each image under its Flickr license (manifest fields license, license_name, license_url)

outputs.saved_image: bytes sent to POST /api/v1/save_image, which the server writes unchanged

adaptations: The browser client is replaced by a headless Python port of IOPaint's web client (iopaint_web.py) that sends the editing path's API requests in order, with the same bodies.

The port does not load the static web UI, does not open the socket.io progress channel, and omits two page-load GETs whose responses no later request uses (/api/v1/inputimage and the Settings dialog's second /api/v1/server-config).

Two settings defaults differ from the browser's: negative_prompt is sent empty and controlnet_method as lllyasviel/control_v11p_sd15_canny (the browser sends a 283-character default negative prompt and an empty controlnet_method). LaMa uses neither field.
Browser canvases are modelled with Pillow; the mask PNG and multipart framing differ byte-wise from a browser's.
Server: placeholder iopaint/web_app/index.html, because the built web UI is not in the git tree and the server will not start without the directory.
Server: all SDPA kernels allowed in IOPaint's vendored SAM 2 (needed on CUDA compute capability >= 8.0; no effect on CPU).

development_hardware.server: 1x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, 16 CPU cores, 64 GB RAM, Linux, Python 3.10
development_hardware.client: Apple Mac, Python 3.11, reaching the server over an SSH tunnel (RTT about 50 ms)
